SMTO-EML-0017 — Your email's message text is too long or not plain text

GUID: 22205f1a-b473-5102-b041-d9fa7e7fe939
Slug: email-body-invalid
Domain: EML · Subsystem: email-smtp

What happened

  • The message text is longer than SMTO allows (about one million characters) or wasn't given as ordinary text. SMTO stopped before sending, so nothing went out.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Shorten the message. Put long reports, logs or data into a file instead of the message text. The message text is limited to about one million characters, but attachments can total up to about 20 MB.
  2. Add the file with the Add context button in the message box, then ask SMTO to send the email with it attached. SMTO can only attach files shared in, or created by, this conversation.
  3. If the message wasn't long, ask SMTO to send it again with the message written as normal text. This error also appears when the message wasn't supplied as ordinary text.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports the mail server accepted the message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. This is about how the email was written, not your email account, so don't change your password or reconnect the account because of it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A supplied text_body or html_body was not a string or exceeded the 1,048,576-character limit, so local validation rejected it before any preparation or dispatch.

What this means

  • The email body has an unsupported type or exceeds the supported length. The producer identifies the failed field or preparation stage without exposing private values.

Why this can happen

  • A supplied body is not a string or exceeds the supported body bound.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reported field, failure phase and retained receipt before choosing a correction.

How to fix it

  • Provide text_body and html_body as strings of at most 1,048,576 characters each, with at least one nonblank. Move large content into an attachment (up to 20 MiB in total).
  • Provide text_body and html_body as strings within the advertised length limits, with at least one nonblank body.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first. Retry only when existing execution and effect evidence permits it; reconcile an uncertain prior send.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected body passes type, size and nonblank validation.

What not to do

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.

Technical notes

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
